 @pytest.mark.parametrize('refname', ('HEAD', 'MERGE_HEAD'))
-def test_get_conflicted_files_with_refname_collision(in_merge_conflict, refname):
+def test_get_conflicted_files_refname_collision(in_merge_conflict, refname):
     """A tracked file sharing a refname must not make `git diff` ambiguous."""
     resolve_conflict()
 
     # a tracked file whose name collides with a refname passed to `git diff`
